prompt: Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.
sentence: There will probably be a lot of fish in their nets, will there?
explanation: A positive statement takes a negative question tag, so it should be 'won't there?'

sentence: Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error. It will take us five and a half hours to reach Jaipur, is it?
explanation: The tag must match the auxiliary of the main clause ('will'), so it should be 'won't it?'.

prompt: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given
